newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares fall to fresh losses in IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares fall to fresh losses in IBIS trade.

text.p: 1445 GMT - German shares fall to fresh losses in post-bourse IBIS trade, hurt by losses on Wall Street and dollar failing to break above 1.70 marks. Traders seek losses as potentially start of long-awaited correction but that drop is healthy for market after 20 percent rise in last 10 weeks.
* IBIS DAX down 50.08 points at 3,332.32 points. DAX ended bourse down 65.59 points at 3,349.81 points.
* Adidas rebounds, rises nearly six percent after falling on Tuesday on profit-taking after 1996 results.
* BMW and Telekom buck trend, trade up as investors seek out laggards in overall market rally.
